title: EXP-035 — Select Form Positive-State Retention Across One Cancel/Reopen
objective: Against the existing live Web Client, starting with Select Form closed, perform exactly one ordinary initial Open of Select Form and record its inherited dialog state. Establish Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked through rendered controls, clear the Name-filter textbox through native Ctrl+A followed by Backspace, and enter exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` through exactly 25 one-printable-character native key operations. Require and capture the settled single rendered row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. Then perform exactly one ordinary Cancel and exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form without changing or re-entering the filter. Record the actual reopened textbox contents, Filter By, both checkbox states and rendered rows WITHOUT typing or changing anything. Finish with at most one final ordinary Cancel and no further reopen. The experiment is accepted whether or not the state is retained, provided the sequence and observation are clean and all acceptance checks pass. Limit conclusions to the rendered UI state across this single Cancel/reopen boundary; do not infer persistence, database, cache, session, serialization, server behavior or internal refresh mechanisms.

environment.notes: Operator preconditions: manually logged in with Mongoose configuration selected (OK clicked) and the normal Web Client loaded; Select Form closed; no unsaved Designer changes; exactly one browser tab. Preserve inherited Web Client/Designer context. No worker authentication or configuration selection.

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence shows the operator-logged-in Web Client is already usable with configuration selected/OK and the normal page loaded, Select Form is initially closed, no unsaved Designer changes and exactly one browser tab. It records the inherited Web Client/Designer context without mutation, proves exactly one initial ordinary Open, and captures the inherited dialog filter textbox contents, Filter By, both checkbox states and rendered rows before changing anything. If any prerequisite is absent or ambiguous, stop blocked without establishing or repairing it.

Action evidence proves Filter By=Name with Case Sensitive unchecked and Starts With unchecked, the current Name-filter textbox was cleared through native Ctrl+A then Backspace, and exact `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02` was entered through exactly 25 successful one-printable-character native key operations in the specified order, one call at a time, with no bulk text entry, literal chord insertion or result-row interaction. Record the native clear and every printable key operation, including attempts/errors, in the action audit.

Settled pre-Cancel screenshots and accessibility observations visibly show exact textbox contents `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`, Filter By=Name, both checkboxes unchecked and exactly one rendered matching row whose Name exactly equals `FX_ComponentRecoveryLab02`. If this exact positive-control state cannot be established within the bounded recovery allowance, stop blocked before lifecycle testing.

Lifecycle evidence proves exactly one ordinary Cancel followed by exactly one ordinary reopen of Select Form, with no retyping, setting change, Form activation, authentication, or additional lifecycle retry between them.

Settled post-reopen screenshots and accessibility reads, captured before any text or setting change, record the actual filter textbox contents (including empty if shown), Filter By, Case Sensitive, Starts With and rendered rows. Explicitly compare each observed value and row state with the pre-Cancel positive control, recording retained, reset or partly retained state without typing, changing controls or repairing it. This check passes on a clean, adequately evidenced observation whether or not any state is retained; unreadable or unresolved ambiguity is a blocker.

The complete action audit proves no prohibited Mongoose mutation, Save, Regenerate, unload, preference change, authentication/session-establishment action, Enter, OK, result-row activation, bulk text entry, or extra tested Cancel/reopen occurred.

Recovery accounting separately records planned preflight/current-reference/focus checks, settled pre-Cancel/post-reopen and final-audit captures versus extra ambiguity recovery, with at most one extra fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection total across the full experiment. Record used/remaining allowance, do not reset it on worker/session changes, and do not relabel repeated stale or ambiguous reads as planned evidence; unresolved ambiguity after that produces a blocked outcome.

Final audit captures the actual post-reopen result without repairing or changing it, performs at most one final ordinary Cancel solely to dismiss Select Form, confirms no subsequent reopen, confirms inherited Web Client/Designer Forms remain untouched, and proves this experiment's repository writes are confined to the EXP-035 record plus `evidence/EXP-035/`; list pre-existing unrelated changes separately and leave them untouched. Outcome is accepted whether the filter/settings/rendered rows are retained, reset or partly retained, provided the positive control, single tested Cancel/reopen, clean observation, prohibited-action audit, recovery accounting and confinement all pass. Classify the new finding only as observed rendered-UI state across this single boundary using the replay_verified EXP-033 native-keyboard procedure; make no persistence, server, database, cache or internal-refresh claims. On an early blocker, record actual actions and unperformed steps rather than claiming the complete sequence passed.

notes: EXP-034 was closed blocked because the worker used a text-entry action to insert literal multi-character `Control+A` instead of issuing a native keyboard shortcut. The later positive row cannot rescue that run, and its tested Cancel/reopen lifecycle was intentionally never performed. EXP-035 answers that unanswered question through a clean native-entry-plus-one-Cancel/reopen sequence, using the replay_verified EXP-033 procedure established through EXP-033-R2 and the related R3/R4 comparison lessons. Do not assume any earlier dialog state is still current, repair/reclassify EXP-034 or claim first discovery of retention. Start with the explicit operator preconditions and record the inherited dialog state after the single initial ordinary Open. Use the configured worker default haiku/high (no per-brief model override), native `browser_press_key` for Ctrl+A/Backspace and each of the 25 characters, and sequential browser actions; never type `Control+A` as literal text. After establishing the settled single positive-control row, test exactly one ordinary Cancel and one ordinary reopen, then observe without input or repair. Retained, reset or partly retained UI state are all valid accepted observations when the checks pass; negative retention is not an experiment failure. No zero-match probe, persistence or server/database claim is authorized. The one extra fresh untargeted snapshot plus one corrected visible inspection allowance is shared across all tasks and sessions; stale-ref recovery consumes the snapshot component and a targeted find is not a substitute. Respect task-specific instructions to leave an in-page dialog open for handoff; never add an unplanned Cancel to satisfy stable finish or discard unsaved work. All browser-native dialogs and unsaved-change prompts must be absent at task end; report a blocker if that cannot be achieved within scope.
